items.notes: Complete vertical slice on the g209 dev candidate: the tenant-scoped privacy console exposes the data map and archive-disposition prerequisites, effect-free subject-erasure and retention reviews, guarded idempotent execution, evidence/history, exact recovery boundaries, and API/CLI automation. Live API/CLI qualification and installed-browser review prove the workflow; irreversible browser confirmation remains an explicit final installed-browser gate rather than an unevidenced waiver.
